title: Yemen: Deepening concerns for Taiz City as aid is blocked from entering
keyFacts: Aid agencies warned on Friday of the fast-developing humanitarian emergency inside Taiz City in Yemen, which has been encircled by de facto Houthi forces fighting government troops along the country’s west coast.

title: World News in Brief: Russian attacks intensify, UN team tours West Bank, ‘unlawful’ elderly deaths
keyFacts: Long-range Russian attacks across Ukraine are intensifying, including in Kyiv, causing at least 14 civilian deaths and 78 injuries overnight into Thursday, as UN agencies continue to provide aid.

title: First human case of Shamonda virus reported in France as patient dies
keyFacts: A patient in France has died after being infected with Shamonda virus, the first recorded human case of the disease.

title: Nepal’s deadly glacier flood a ‘defining moment’ for the international community
keyFacts: The deadly flash flood that tore through Nepal in August is a “defining moment” for both the country and the international community, according to the head of the UN field agency which builds roads, schools and clinics in crisis zones.
